finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0 with 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding in that warning noise, both from the options object shape changing after the bump:

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That was `undefined`, so calling `.toFixed(0)` on it crashed the build. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only handled `backoffEnabled` as `true` or `false`, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset — so it threw instead of just treating that as disabled. Fixed to treat `undefined` as `false`.

The rest really was just noise — deprecation warnings from the bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc.) and repeated tree-shaking notes.

```
node build.js
```
